as_told.title: John Alexander's early knowledge of Rendlesham

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that John Alexander, whom he calls a Colonel, knew about the Rendlesham incident, a 1980 report of strange lights and craft near an air base called RAF Woodbridge in England, before almost anyone else in the United States. In one telling Michels says this came from a well-connected friend and that Alexander gave the readout, while in another he gives no source at all. If true, it would mean word of the event reached a few Americans unusually fast.
